pages.text: $(1)PROGRAM primefinder$(br)NOOP$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION main$(br)  RESULT primes STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  FOR candidate INTEGER 2 ; 20 ;$(br)  BEGIN$(br)    VARIABLE prime BOOLEAN TRUE$(br)    FOR divisor INTEGER 2 ; candidate - 1 ;$(br)    BEGIN$(br)      IF candidate \ divisor = 0 ;$()

$(1)      BEGIN$(br)        ASSIGN prime FALSE ;$(br)        BREAK$(br)      END IF$(br)    END FOR$(br)    IF prime ;$(br)    BEGIN$(br)      ASSIGN primes primes ⊕ candidate ⊕ " " ;$(br)    END IF$(br)  END FOR$(br)END FUNCTION$()

The outer loop tries every number from 2 to 20. The inner loop checks if a smaller number divides it with no remainder ($(1)\$()). If so, it is no prime, and BREAK stops the inner loop. The result is "2 3 5 7 11 13 17 19 ".
